about: Values a kind cannot hold (ADR-0065), each refused naming its row, counted from 1 across record batches, and its column: a decimal no decimal holds, a uint64 past a 64-bit integer, a date outside 0001 to 9999, a time outside a day, a nanosecond finer than 100, a dictionary index outside its dictionary, text that is not UTF-8 and a view that points outside its data. Transcribed from ExGrid.Data.Arrow.Tests' RefusalTests.

refused.message: Row 5, column 'Notional': the decimal128(38, 0) value -79228162514264337593543950336 lies beyond the range of a decimal.
